subject: EMR keeps freezing on WOW
text: The medication cart computer on 3 East keeps freezing whenever I open the medication administration record, right in the middle of a med pass.
resolution: Root cause was the print spooler service on the cart hanging; restarting the spooler service cleared it permanently for that cart.

subject: Scanner won't read new armbands
text: Since the new wristband stock arrived the barcode scanners at bed 4 and 5 won't read them at all.
resolution: New wristband stock had a slightly different print contrast; ribbon replacement on the wristband printer fixed legibility and scanning both.

subject: VPN keeps kicking me off
text: My VPN disconnects roughly every 12 minutes while I work from home, then reconnects on its own.
resolution: Client idle-timeout setting was too aggressive; increased to 30 minutes in the client profile, no further drops reported.

subject: Locked out again
text: I keep getting locked out of my account most mornings, I think because I mistype my password half asleep.
resolution: Advised the user to wait out the lockout window rather than retrying, and to use the password manager's autofill instead of typing manually.

subject: Authenticator app stopped prompting
text: Got a new phone yesterday and now the authenticator app just sits there, no codes ever come through.
resolution: MFA was still registered to the old device; re-enrolled the new phone in the authenticator app and the prompts resumed.

subject: Phishing email about a parcel delivery
text: Got an email saying a parcel delivery failed and to click a link to reschedule, looks fake to me.
resolution: Confirmed phishing, sender domain not affiliated with any courier. Message quarantined org-wide, user did not click through.

subject: Laptop left on the bus
text: I think I left my work laptop on the bus this morning, I've called the transit lost and found but no luck yet.
resolution: Remote wipe initiated as a precaution once the device did not check in within the expected window; no recovery of the laptop.

subject: Copier out of toner constantly
text: The copier on the third floor says low toner about once a week even right after a cartridge change.
resolution: Toner sensor was miscalibrated after the last service visit; vendor recalibrated it, false low-toner warnings stopped.

subject: Print queue frozen
text: Nothing will print from the finance floor printer, there's a queue of about 15 jobs just sitting there.
resolution: Print spooler service was hung; restarting the spooler cleared the stuck queue and printing resumed.

subject: Outlook keeps asking for my password
text: Outlook pops up a credential prompt every ten minutes or so even though my password hasn't changed.
resolution: Cleared the cached credentials for the account in Windows Credential Manager; prompts stopped without a password reset.

subject: Video calls freeze after a minute
text: Every Teams call I join freezes up after about a minute, audio keeps going but the video is stuck.
resolution: User was roaming between two access points near a stairwell; moving to a desk with stronger single-AP coverage resolved it.

subject: Need Visio for org chart work
text: I've been asked to build out our new org chart and need Visio installed, my manager already said it's fine.
resolution: Manager approval logged, Visio licence assigned and installed same day.

subject: App broke after the Windows update
text: Ever since the update rolled out last week the scheduling app crashes on launch, used to work fine.
resolution: Known incompatibility between the app version and the new OS build; rolled back to the previous known-good app version pending a vendor patch.

subject: Desktop won't turn on
text: My desktop at the nurses station won't power on at all this morning, no lights, nothing.
resolution: Power supply unit had failed; replaced PSU and the desktop powered on normally.

subject: Whole unit can't chart
text: Nobody on 4B can access the EMR right now, we've had to switch to paper for the last twenty minutes.
resolution: Interface outage between the EMR and the identity provider; escalated to the vendor, service restored after 40 minutes.

subject: Ransom note on my screen
text: My files all have a new extension and there's a message demanding payment to get them back.
resolution: Device isolated from the network immediately per the ransomware runbook; confirmed contained to a single endpoint, reimaged from backup.

subject: Wifi drops in the stairwell office
text: My laptop loses wifi every time I'm in the small office off the west stairwell, fine everywhere else.
resolution: Confirmed a coverage gap for that room; added to the access-point placement backlog rather than troubleshooting the laptop further.

subject: Asked to reset a colleague's password
text: Can you reset the password for someone on my team, they're out sick and I need to check something in their inbox.
resolution: Declined as a routine reset; referred to identity governance for a documented approval before any access to another person's account.

subject: Wristband printer prints blank
text: The wristband printer at admitting is producing completely blank labels, nothing on them at all.
resolution: Ribbon was loaded backwards after a cartridge change; correcting ribbon orientation fixed it immediately.

subject: Scan to email not arriving
text: I scan a document on the 2nd floor machine and select my email but nothing ever shows up in my inbox.
resolution: The printer's stored SMTP credentials had expired after a password rotation; re-entered current credentials on the device.

subject: Suspicious call asking for my login code
text: Someone called claiming to be IT and asked me to read out my authenticator code, I did before I thought about it.
resolution: Treated as likely compromise; forced a credential reset and re-enrolled MFA, reviewed sign-in logs for unauthorized access.

subject: Order entry timing out at shift change
text: Every day right around 7am the order entry screen in the EMR times out for a few minutes.
resolution: Confirmed the pattern matches known end-of-shift load; no fix needed beyond documenting the expected window for future tickets.

subject: Headset mic not picking up
text: My headset mic doesn't seem to pick up my voice on calls anymore, worked fine last week.
resolution: Mute switch on the headset cable had been toggled accidentally; no hardware fault found.

subject: MFA rejects every code
text: Every code my authenticator app generates gets rejected as invalid, I've tried five times.
resolution: Phone's clock had drifted by several minutes after a time-zone change; correcting the device clock fixed TOTP validation immediately.

subject: Cart battery dies fast
text: The workstation on wheels in bay 2 loses all its charge within about an hour of being undocked.
resolution: Battery was well past its rated cycle count; scheduled for replacement, no software fault.

subject: Shared mailbox access needed
text: Please add me to the HR shared inbox, my manager said it's approved for my new role.
resolution: Manager approval confirmed, added as a delegate to the shared mailbox same day.

subject: Laptop screen won't wake up
text: My laptop screen stays black after I open the lid, I can hear the fan running though.
resolution: External monitor had been left connected and the laptop was outputting only to that port; disconnecting it restored the built-in screen.

subject: Lab results interface down
text: None of our released results are reaching the chart today, techs are having to call results in verbally.
resolution: Interface service between the lab system and the EMR had stopped; restarted the interface service, backlog processed within the hour.

subject: New starter needs an account
text: We have someone starting in payroll on Monday and they'll need a network account and email set up.
resolution: Provisioned the account and mailbox ahead of the start date once the request form was completed.

subject: Network cable dead in meeting room
text: The wired connection in meeting room C is dead, laptop says cable unplugged even though it's plugged in.
resolution: Wall port was disabled at the switch from a previous move; re-enabled the port, connection restored.
